definitions.explanation: A sport in which two teams of eleven players try to kick a ball into the opposing team's goal.

examples.japanese: サッカーの{試合|しあい}を{見|み}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to watch a soccer match.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{小学校|しょうがっこう}からサッカーを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: My son started playing soccer in elementary school.

examples.japanese: ワールドカップはサッカーの{世界|せかい}{大会|たいかい}だ。
examples.english: The World Cup is a global soccer tournament.

notes:
サッカー comes from English "soccer." In most of the world this sport is called "football," but Japan uses the American term.

Common expressions:
- サッカーをする (to play soccer)
- サッカー{選手|せんしゅ} (soccer player)
- サッカー{部|ぶ} (soccer club)
- サッカーボール (soccer ball)
